decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-6d976955075b] states one concrete change: a dependabot "chore(deps)" bump of github/codeql-action from 3.28.12 to 3.28.13 (PR #4607). That is enough to identify the subject and the before and after versions. It also supports writing applicability as "no customer environment exposed" with an informational, no-consequence outcome, because the item is a repository dependency chore and not a shipped setting, image or API. Confidence is low because the excerpt never says outright that the action is CI-only, and the line appears under a "BREAKING CHANGES › What's Changed" locator without any breaking wording of its own.
